story.paragraph: A bride and groom stand before an officiant at an outdoor wedding ceremony by the water. The camera pans to show the guests watching from behind. A man and a woman in the guest area hold hands and look at each other. The woman then reaches down to hold the hand of another woman sitting next to her, and they exchange a few words. Finally, the three guests stand together watching the ceremony.
story.summary: Guests at an outdoor wedding ceremony hold hands and watch the bride and groom.

story.paragraph: A man and a brown dog, both covered in white cream, stand in a rustic room. The man is laughing and holding a metallic object, while the dog puts on a cone hat. The group stands watching them, with one woman holding a small cake with a candle.
